title: Iraq’s Prime Minister Aims to Wrest More Power from Kurdistan Region
summary_full: Ali al-Zaidi, who just scored a symbolic victory against a powerful Iran-backed militia, has now moved to assert control over Kurdish border crossings and oil resources.
